<!-- Date: 2026-11-11; Version: 4.
Reproducing statement: Provide the Markdown counterpart of the matching public issue form for a concise, actionable report; omit optional sections without useful content.
Changelog: 2026-11-11 — Align sanitized security reporting with SECURITY.md.
-->

Keep secrets, personal information and private Project data out of this report. Follow SECURITY.md for security concerns; share only a sanitized summary without confidential exploit details.

## Observed problem

Describe the failure and its effect on your work.

## Reproduce it

Give the actions that trigger it, using only publicly shareable data.

## Expected behavior

Explain the result those actions should produce.

## Setup details (optional)

Include the app version or commit, operating system, browser and Node version when known. Omit this section if unavailable.

## Extra evidence (optional)

Attach relevant links or sanitized logs and images. Omit this section when there is nothing to add.
